_meta.description: Structured reference derived from az_hud_reference.md. AZ statute has NO defined 'normal wear and tear' standard or useful-life table -- all useful_life_years and wear/damage example phrases below are HUD industry guidance (non-binding on private AZ landlords), not Arizona law. Always surface both citation types separately in output.
_meta.az_operative_statute: A.R.S. § 33-1341(6): tenant liable for damage that is 'deliberately or negligently' caused; ordinary deterioration is not chargeable.
_meta.hud_source_citation: HUD Special Claims Processing Guide (HSG-06-01), June 2006, Chapter 5, Appendix 5C & 5D
_meta.proration_formula: max_chargeable = repair_or_replacement_cost * (remaining_useful_life_years / total_useful_life_years); 0 if item already past useful life
